recommendations.reason: Complete selecting source and matching reconstruction establish preparation disconnection, but not a safe early-discovery transaction. Earlier helper proposals do not validate the global progression gate, accepted stash/effect recovery, or restoration of still-uncollected gold. Allowing grass would weaken the return safety filter. Next derive paired decision-708/709/710 fixtures and validate bounded preparation reservation at 709, preserving room supplies and the collection objective, with accepted transit/drop/drink/retrieval receipts, interruption handling and fresh pickup-route resumption. Require a new baseline-red/candidate-green regression before changing arbitration; do not waive pickup or restore death waits.

review.review: The living hero exhausted mandatory potion discovery, not combat or the game clock. Decision 709 (selected line 2065, accepted line 2066) follows the final gold route from grass 623 to grass 622, disconnecting remembered preparation banks under the stricter return rules. Decision 711 actually collects the gold; decision 712 then has no admitted protected test bank or preparation return. Source-pinned offline reconstruction matched all 712 earlier selections, reasons, intents and controllers. Detached earlier-state probes could select preparation before disconnection, but did not establish safe early activation, complete stash/effect recovery, and resumption of unfinished pickup. No patch or new regression is supplied: those transaction guarantees remain unvalidated, and admitting grass would weaken the existing safety restriction. Source browsing resolved the missing selecting-state uncertainty. The existing suite passed 1,955 tests with four skips; this is not repair validation.
review.learnings: Reserve an executable preparation return before the last collection route disconnects it. A feasible bank or proposed preparation move is not proof of completed identification or retrieval. Preserve unfinished loot, reserved puzzle supplies, fresh arrival checks and accepted collection receipts. The previous summoning-quarantine diagnosis does not establish this recording's cause.
